title: Monday and Thursday Sunnah Fasting: Can It Help You Lose Weight?
intro: Sunnah fasting can help you lose weight if the total amount you eat in a week goes down. But if you eat too much when breaking fast, the effect on your weight may end up the same.

sections.p: When fasting, you usually skip breakfast, snacks and lunch. This can reduce your total calories for the week. The key is to keep your buka puasa and dinner in your usual portions.
Have sahur with protein and carbs that keep you full longer. For example, oats with eggs, or a little rice with chicken and vegetables. Drink enough plain water and cut down on very salty food.
Start with dates and plain water. Then eat one moderate plate with protein and vegetables. Kuih for buka puasa is fine, but pick just one or two because each one is an estimated 100-200 calories.
Some people eat more on Tuesday and Friday to 'make up'. Try to eat as usual on non-fasting days. Consistency throughout the week is what gives results.

sections.h: Look after your health and follow religious rulings
sections.p: If you have gastric problems, diabetes, thyroid problems, are pregnant or take certain medication, consult your doctor first. For religious questions like fasting during your period or replacing missed fasts, ask an ustazah you trust.

action: Prepare simple sahur ingredients the night before.
Break your fast with plain water first, not sweet drinks.
Limit buka puasa kuih to one or two pieces.
Take a light 10-15 minute walk after breaking fast.
Write down what you eat on fasting days and normal days for one week.
myth: Many people believe sunnah fasting will definitely make them lose weight. In reality, it depends on how much you eat over the week, so overeating at buka puasa can cancel out the effect.

faq.a: Yes, but choose light or moderate exercise. Good times are before breaking fast or 1-2 hours after breaking fast. Stop if you feel dizzy or too weak.

faq.q: If I skip sahur, will I lose weight faster?
faq.a: Not necessarily. Without sahur, you may feel hungrier and overeat when breaking fast. A simple sahur helps you stay more in control.

faq.q: I have gastric problems. Can I do sunnah fasting?
faq.a: This needs to be discussed with your doctor. Everyone is different, so get advice before you start fasting regularly.
